finding: bs3DaudioMode selects signalled 3D-stereo TTT matrix inversion, not binaural output. Five directions, amplitude=10^((index-16)/20), IPD=index*pi/16. Cross-ear front/rear phase is energy weighted; phase only below parameter band12. Fixed surround gain enters rear energy. Arbitrary-downmix gains precede inversion. Standard inverse has priority in modes0/1/2/4;otherwise signalled3D is selected.
regularization: Floor determinant magnitude at0.1 via singular values; preserve larger singular value unless both below sqrt(0.1). Rust uses Hermitian eigenbasis with determinant-derived small singular value;independent Decimal reference uses polar factor. Rank-deficient phase completion fixed explicitly and checked analytically.
reference_limitation: Stock float C SVD loses orthogonality and produces nonfinite results near rank deficiency. These are retained in the reference audit,not used as stable truth. Original C raw basis and M2 remain independent controls.
